0.original: Managingway would have you assist an artist struggling to find their Way.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Search for the muttering Loporrit in Greatest Endsvale.

24.original: Search for the muttering Loporrit in Greatest Endsvale.

48.original: Some of our artists have been so prolific in their painting that they now claim to lack sufficient inspiration.

49.original: One Way in particular has become quite disheartened─so much so that they have taken to conversing with the very nothingness that plagues them. To be frank, I'm more than somewhat concerned.

50.original: I do hate to trouble you with such a gloomy affair, but could you perhaps offer them some encouragement? You should find them wandering Greatest Endsvale and muttering sad words.

52.original: Aaah! Y-You frightened me. Have you come to hear of my emptiness?

53.original: With these two paws, I have depicted my entire existence. The moon. The Loporrits. The...well, that's about it, really. I have painted <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> and now nothing seems new <hex:021A020203>or<hex:021A020103> interesting. Oh, whatever is left for me...?

56.original: You could try drawing a person.

57.original: Bunnies. Lots and lots of bunnies.

58.original: Etheirys? But so many Ways have already painted it. A bright, blue orb suspended in unending darkness...

59.original: But wait! If I were to draw the landscapes that may or may not exist <hex:021A020203>upon<hex:021A020103> Etheirys...that could be very lovely!

60.original: A person? If you only knew how many Ways have drawn the people who were meant to join us...the people who never came...

61.original: But wait! If I were to draw a Loporrit <hex:021A020203>as<hex:021A020103> a person...that could be something remarkable!

63.original: Etheirys has Loporrits!? Why haven't I heard of this!? I must draw them straightaway!

64.original: I feel alive again─inspired! I didn't think it possible. Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. And thanks to Managingway for sending you!

65.original: Right on schedule! Our muttering friend has gotten straight to work at the imaging station, and I managed to sneak a glance at their progress.

66.original: I do believe they are recreating images from Etheirys. Regardless of accuracy, the awe they hold for Mother Hydaelyn's star is palpable in their work.

67.original: It is...unique to say the least. “Terrifying,” may be a more accurate word. A beast of neither man nor Loporrit, grinning eerily from the confines of a dark prison...? Ahem.

68.original: I do believe they are drawing what you would call a “bunny.” While anatomically questionable, their work exhibits a tangible curiosity and excitement regarding the creatures.

69.original: At the end of the day, the priority of art is its creation, not its analysis. So long as our Way remains bright-eyed and bushy-tailed, I am quite satisfied.

70.original: Still, the flow of inspiration is known to be fickle, so I may call upon you again should our Ways require it. Until next time.
